name: Mail delivery via Resend
description: Real e-mail delivery through the Resend HTTPS API (the Render free tier blocks outbound SMTP). Without RESEND_API_KEY on the server it falls back to the base log transport (simulated).

settings.label: Log prefix (fallback)
settings.help: Used by the base log transport when RESEND_API_KEY is not set.

settings.label: Sender address
settings.help: Verified sender on the Resend domain. The API key is NEVER a setting: it lives in the RESEND_API_KEY environment variable on the server.
